message.content: { "drugs": [ {"generic": "furosemide", "plain_purpose": "a water pill that helps your body get rid of extra fluid", "common_side_effects": ["nausea", "diarrhea", "dizziness", "cramping"], "key_warning": "can cause severe dehydration and electrolyte imbalance if dose is too high" }, {"generic": "lisinopril", "plain_purpose": "a medicine that lowers blood pressure and helps the heart", "common_side_effects": ["cough", "dizziness", "headache", "low blood pressure"], "key_warning": "can cause serious harm or death to an unborn baby" }, {"generic": "carvedilol", "plain_purpose": "a medicine that helps the heart work better and lowers blood pressure", "common_side_effects": ["dizziness", "tiredness", "low blood pressure", "slow heartbeat"], "key_warning": "do not stop taking suddenly; can cause worse chest pain or heart attack" }, {"generic": "clopidogrel", "plain_purpose": "a blood thinner that helps prevent heart attacks and strokes", "common_side_effects": ["bleeding", "bruising", "stomach upset", "nosebleeds"], "key_warning": "increases risk of serious bleeding; do not stop without doctor's advice" }, {"generic": "rosuvastatin", "plain_purpose": "a medicine that lowers cholesterol", "common_side_effects": ["headache", "muscle pain", "stomach pain", "feeling tired"], "key_warning": "can cause severe muscle damage that may lead to kidney problems" }, {"generic": "nitroglycerin", "plain_purpose": "a medicine to prevent chest pain from heart disease", "common_side_effects": ["headache", "dizziness", "low blood pressure", "fainting"], "key_warning": "can cause dangerous low blood pressure if taken with certain other medicines" }, {"generic": "naproxen", "plain_purpose": "a pain reliever that reduces swelling and inflammation", "common_side_effects": ["stomach upset", "heartburn", "dizziness", "headache"], "key_warning": "increases risk of heart attack, stroke, and serious stomach bleeding" } ] }
